content.comment_body: Hello, how can I change the unit ID? I tried selecting the checkbox and updating it, but when I revisit the setting, it still shows 255.

You have configured the [product_name] to act as the server in your setup. In this scenario, the unit ID refers to the [product_name]'s unit ID. My understanding is that the unit ID for the [product_name] is fixed at 255 and cannot actually be changed, even though it appears possible.

It is possible to change the unit ID from the [product_name] acting as server, but you must fill in all required fields first, such as settings, length, and direction. Leaving fields empty will cause the configuration line to be ignored, and on the next access, you will see the default starting value of 255 for the ID.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report difficulty changing the Modbus unit ID on the [product_name] when set as a server. The interface seems to allow modification, but the value returns to 255 unless all required settings are provided. There is uncertainty about whether the unit ID is truly changeable, leading to confusion and reduced trust in the configuration process.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that changing the Modbus unit ID via the interface will be saved and remain effective upon returning to the configuration settings.
